_readme: AI Creative Lab gallery. To add work: put videos in assets/lab/videos/ and images in assets/lab/images/ (optional poster images in assets/lab/posters/), then add an entry to `items`. categories: any of "AI Videos", "Animation", "AI Art", "Experiments". type: "video" or "image". Optional fields: poster, tools, link, linkLabel, duration, language, featured. Leave unknown fields out; they are hidden, never guessed.

items.title: Blur → Blast: Game Over
items.description: A game-style recap of Blur and Blast: $2.3B deposited before the chain was even live, the points-fuelled boom, a $62M exploit, and TVL down 97% from the peak. Two products that ran on rewards, and went quiet when the rewards stopped.

items.title: Grok Bot: It Works While I Sleep
items.description: An intro to Grok Bot: what it can and can’t do, its Canva, Figma, and Google Slides skills, roughly what it costs, and how it moved my work from creator to editor.

items.title: Got X Premium+? Make Videos with Grok Bot
items.description: A step-by-step tutorial for making videos with Grok Bot: open x.ai/bot, write a clear prompt (topic, language, length, style), review drafts until they feel right, render, and add an ElevenLabs voiceover safely. Start small, stay consistent.

items.title: XPass: Everything in One Subscription?
items.description: A case-file breakdown of a rumoured X subscription bundle: four leaked tiers from Plus to Ultra, the Grok and AI features in each, and what happens to existing Premium and SuperGrok plans. Rumour, not official.

items.title: Cold DMs: Then vs. Now
items.description: How cold DMs to founders opened doors for me in 2023, before AI, how the same approach still works today with Dirol on Monad, and how AI now does the heavy lifting. AI writes faster, but the DM still needs to be you.

items.title: HelloTrade: Meet the Team
items.description: An animated intro to HelloTrade on Monad: founders who helped launch BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF (IBIT), advisors including Arthur Hayes, Josh Lim, and Larry Florio, and a mission to make global capital markets accessible to everyone.

items.title: Moncock: A Rooster on Monad
items.description: A fight-card style breakdown of $MONCOCK, a Monad memecoin built around a community mascot: the origin story, why it’s so memeable, the tale of the tape, and a possible catalyst. Education, not financial advice; disclosure included in the video.

items.title: Bitget Masih SAFU?
items.description: A Bahasa Indonesia explainer after a hack scare: Bitget’s staged withdrawal schedule for BTC, ETH, and USDT, a real test trade, the big-picture withdrawal numbers, and the lessons: don’t panic, check official info, and do your own research.

items.title: What Even Is Dirol?
items.description: A 10-part explainer on Dirol, a social trading app on Monad: swaps, charts, limit orders, and new tokens in one app, one-click non-custodial trading, spot and perps, and how to join the whitelist. Education, not financial advice.

items.title: Dirol Itu Apa Sih?
items.description: The Bahasa Indonesia version of the Dirol explainer: a social trading app on Monad with swaps, charts, limit orders, one-click non-custodial trading, spot and perps, and how to join the whitelist. Education, not financial advice.

items.title: The Mutual Fun
items.description: A short look at The Mutual Fun on Robinhood Chain: five on-chain funds run by the people who hold them, no owner and no upgrade path, and how to apply for a soulbound TMF Pass.

items.title: The Mutual Fun: Mutuals
items.description: A cinematic follow-up on The Mutual Fun’s Mutuals desk: swipe-style applications, a 72-hour window for pass holders, and a system built on working together.

items.title: botdirectory.ai: Ready-to-Copy Grok Bot Prompts
items.description: A quick discovery video on botdirectory.ai: a public, open-source directory of hundreds of ready-to-copy Grok Bot prompts for marketing, sales, productivity, ops, and more. Browse, copy, launch.

items.title: Revenge Trade: Abis Fumble, Pengen Bales Dendam?
items.description: A Bahasa Indonesia trading-psychology explainer: what revenge trading is (emotion, not setup), a personal overtrading story, why stopping and sleeping was the right call, and the lesson. Education, not financial advice.

items.title: Make Videos with Grok CLI + Remotion
items.description: A beginner tutorial on making videos with an AI coding agent: install Grok CLI, open a terminal, add the Remotion skill, prompt clearly, and render straight to MP4. No design degree needed.

items.title: Apa itu Bagworking? Crypto Memecoin
items.description: An animated explainer in Bahasa Indonesia on bagworking in memecoin communities: what a bag is, what bag workers actually do (content, replies, raids, community, narrative), and the risks. Work does not guarantee a pump.

items.title: Apa itu NFT? Panduan Pemula
items.description: A beginner's guide to NFTs in Bahasa Indonesia: fungible vs. non-fungible, NFTs as unique digital certificates on the blockchain, what they're used for, and how mint, wallet, trade, and on-chain records fit together.
